title: JSON to Python Dataclass
description: Convert JSON to Python @dataclass models — nested classes, List/Dict/Optional typing included.
howto: Click Generate to build the dataclasses.
Copy the code or download models.py.

faqs.a: Each nested object becomes its own @dataclass, referenced by the parent field.
As List[ItemType] with field(default_factory=list) so mutable defaults are safe.
They become Optional[UnknownType] = None — the real type cannot be known from null alone.
The output uses dataclasses and typing, so Python 3.7+.
